§6Starmetal§f

§aAn alloy from space. Obscenely dense, reacts violently with moon rock, and essential for exotic crafting.§f

§bStarmetal§f is a natural alloy found in asteroids and meteorites. You do not need to go to space for it though. Combine §bSaturnite§f with §bMeteorite Powder§f in a blast furnace for a reliable Earth-side source.

§6Make It§f:
§b•§f Blast Furnace: Saturnite + Meteorite Powder -> §eStarmetal§f
§b•§f Meteorite mining or Asteroid Mining Ship (slow)

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bSchrabidium Clusters§f, exotic material crafting
§b•§f §bRadiation-Powered Engine§f, generates power from static or radiation
§b•§f §bTesla Coils§f, static electricity generation
§b•§f §bTrottenheimer's Folly§f, the starmetal-moonrock reaction is what makes it devastating
§b•§f Artillery shells and armor-piercing bullets
§b•§f Tom's final stage

§ePS:§f Saturnite is a mid-game alloy from the rotary furnace. If you have been keeping up with petroleum processing, you already have the ingredients.
